items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I lived in a -- in later years I lived in an apartment building out in Los Angeles where Tatum lived... Willy lived there, I lived there, and Art lived upstairs.

ctx.x: Earl used to like to go out and play a lot. Earl would. It was fun when we played with Earl because he'd say let's go out and play -- a few of us -- this place or that place. And we'd go out after we got through work and play all night.
Tatum was playing in Chicago then wasn't he?
Yes, he was. Very much so. Yeah. Watch out when he came around, boy. He was -- he would really put all the piano players out of business.
